constraints: D7 and K't'inga configuration/variant identity must remain date-aware
do not collapse every Klingon cruiser into one exact specification
crew_generation: command and House context remain separate from ship class
persistence: refit/variant changes preserve individual vessel identity when explicit
ai_boundary: Klingon class does not prove House ownership, captain personality or current hostility.
visual_hooks: D7/K't'inga lineage recognizable but dated hull/configuration differences preserved

constraints: variant scale and capability differ substantially
class designation must be known before exact staffing/capability assumptions
crew_generation: B'rel-scale crews can be very small
larger K'Vort-like variants require much larger staffing
boarding/ground-force embarkation only when mission requires
persistence: wing/mechanical state and cloak condition are live systems
variant does not change because of camera scale
ai_boundary: Do not infer exact Bird-of-Prey subtype from generic silhouette unless sensors/knowledge support it.
visual_hooks: cloak visual state from World State

constraints: House/political ownership is separate from class
crew_generation: large combatant staffing with command, engineering, tactical, support and embarked forces only as mission requires
persistence: battle damage/refits stay on individual vessel
ai_boundary: Do not treat every Vor'cha as hostile or as belonging to a specific House.

generation_rules: Klingon species does not imply Imperial military membership.
House interests, military assignment and vessel operator/owner state are separate.
Cloak capability presence does not imply current cloak state or perfect undetectability.
Older designs may remain in service when date/source supports it.
unknown_policy: Do not import disputed fan technical specifications or force exact crew counts where screen canon is ambiguous.
nap_implications: Era and design family resolve before House markings, individual identity, damage and cloak/current-state overlays.
